description: General contract-law reference addressing formation, interpretation, and the enforceability of routine contractual terms.

obligations.title: Clarity of Obligations and Definitions
obligations.description: Use defined terms and clear obligation language to reduce ambiguity and support consistent contract interpretation.

obligations.title: Notice and Cure Mechanics
obligations.description: Termination and breach remedies commonly require explicit notice, cure periods, and defined methods of delivery to support enforceability.

obligations.title: Allocation of Remedies
obligations.description: Limit or define remedies and damages where appropriate, including how injunctive relief is handled for confidentiality breaches.
